At n8n@2.34.0, packages/cli/src/controllers/oauth/oauth2-credential.controller.ts convertCredentialToOptions maps credential.accessTokenUrl to ClientOAuth2Options.accessTokenUri and handleCallback constructs `new ClientOAuth2(oAuthOptions)` then `oAuthObj.code.getToken`. packages/@n8n/client-oauth2/src/code-flow.ts POSTs that URL; client-oauth2.ts:97-121 axios.request has no URL/DNS/redirect SSRF check. OauthService.http uses OutboundHttp with SSRF for discovery/DCR (`this.http.request` around oauth.service.ts:1115/1338), so token exchange is a separate unguarded client.

Impact is bounded SSRF plus response disclosure: ClientOAuth2.ResponseError stores response.data; at n8n@2.34.0 oauth.service.ts:649-651 extractCallbackErrorReason jsonStringifies error.body into oauth-error-callback. Success stores oauthToken.data onto the credential.
